sections.label: Recycling bins and programmes
sections.summary: HDB blocks, condominiums, private apartments and landed property have recycling bins or centralised chutes, and surveys show household and commercial recycling rates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Every Housing and Development Board (HDB) block, condominium and private apartment development and landed property is served by recycling bins or a centralised chute for recyclables (CCR).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Based on a National Environment Agency (NEA) survey conducted over 2015 and 2016, about 83% of households practised recycling.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Based on NEA's data on the commercial sector, 94% of large hotels and shopping malls have implemented recycling programmes for their premises.

sections.label: Domestic recycling rate growth
sections.summary: The non-domestic recycling rate has been high, while the domestic recycling rate grew gradually to 21% in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: While the recycling rate for the non-domestic sector has been high, our domestic recycling rate has grown only gradually, to 21% in 2017.

sections.label: Contamination rate average
sections.summary: The contamination rate is about 40% on average.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The contamination rate is about 40% on average.

sections.label: Dual chutes system requirement
sections.summary: HDB's 2012 study found dual chute blocks contribute up to three times more recyclables, so dual chutes are required for BTO flats from 2014 and private non-landed developments above four storeys from 1 April.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to dual chutes, HDB's study in 2012 showed that blocks with dual chutes system, that means, one for waste and one for recyclables, actually contribute up to three times more recyclables than the blocks without those chutes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Because of this, HDB has implemented the dual chutes system for all the BTO flats launched from 2014, and we are requiring private non-landed residential developments above four storeys to also have this dual chute system from 1 April.

sections.label: Glass pieces recycling
sections.summary: Even glass pieces, particularly larger pieces, can be recovered for recycling.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Actually, even for glass pieces, particularly for the larger pieces, they can be recovered for recycling.
